intent.summary: Arranges children sequentially from block-start to block-end on the vertical axis.
useWhen: Sibling order is meaningful and vertical
Content height should be the sum of child extents and gaps

semantics.sizing: cross-axis size is the maximum child extent; main-axis size is children plus gaps
semantics.ordering: document order from top to bottom in left-to-right and right-to-left locales

accessibility.nameSource: none unless the group has independent meaning
accessibility.focusBehavior: container is not focusable; descendants retain document order
notes: Visual and accessibility order must agree.

mappings.strategy: Preserve child order, spacing, and horizontal alignment.
caveats: Lazy realization is a performance policy, not semantic identity.

mappings.strategy: Use rows when sizing constraints matter; otherwise a vertical StackPanel is valid.
caveats: StackPanel measures unbounded on its main axis.
